# Muhammet Atmaca — Mobile & Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Muhammet Atmaca is a software engineer based in Samsun, Turkey (working remotely worldwide), specializing in native and cross-platform mobile app development (React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin), full-stack web platforms (Next.js, ASP.NET Core, Node.js), and scalable cloud architecture. He has published and maintained over 50 mobile applications on Apple App Store and Google Play Store, and has 7+ years of professional engineering experience.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)**: Turnkey mobile apps using React Native and Flutter. 60 FPS UI animations, in-app purchases (IAP / RevenueCat), push notifications (OneSignal / FCM), background audio/video, Bluetooth, camera, and payment gateway integrations.
- **App Store & Google Play Store Compliance**: 100% store submission and approval track record adhering to Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Google Play Developer Policies.
- **Web Platforms & Full-Stack Systems**: Next.js (SSR/SSG), TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis. Ultra-fast, 100/100 Google Core Web Vitals performance and technical SEO.
- **Software Architecture & Technical Consulting**: Codebase audit, security & performance tuning, microservices architecture, and resolving App Store rejections.
